title: Inverted Estate Auction
description: A surreal scene depicts a dark auction in a gothic hall under a cosmic sky with a large red ringed planet. A white-haired auctioneer with glowing eyes stands at a podium holding a glowing orb, while a tall armored warrior with a '523' tag observes; the background blends desert dunes, lavender fields, floating artifacts, lightning, and a crowd of onlookers.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of an inverted estate auction under a dark teal sky dominated by a massive red ringed planet with glowing triangular symbols. A pale-skinned auctioneer with glowing yellow eyes and black robes stands at an ornate podium holding a glowing orb with three eyes, next to a tall armored warrior with long white hair, a sword, and a black tag numbered 523. Floating artifacts include a skull with three eyes and a glass orb containing bread. The background merges gothic architecture, a crowd of shadowy figures, desert dunes with a distant traveler, and vibrant purple lavender fields with dripping golden liquid. Dramatic lightning illuminates purple and yellow clouds with melting drips, in a detailed illustrative style with high contrast and vibrant accents.
